name: Lars
source:
A hard-working fox descendant, and our story protagonist. As the dragon pilot for the guild ‘Custodes Sylvae’, Lars is known for his love of adventure and unwavering dedication to taking care of those around him, dragons, descendants, and reincarnates alike.

He's prone to rambling and bouts of anxiety when he’s excited. But, he always finds the courage to protect his guildmates, even if it means putting himself in harm’s way.

[From [url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/love-amidst-the-timeless-rift]official profile[/url]]
